title: capabilities: the registry has no per-token provider identity, so the CLI wiring check matches any security-enterprise class
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope follow-up from objectstack#34726 (draft PR #35168, Acceptance notes; premise 6972083658), filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is open

#35168's "provider present but not wired into `plugins[]`" check counts any class exported by `@objectstack/security-enterprise` as the provider, because the capability registry has no per-token plugin identity. It can therefore miss a stack that wires the wrong class.

## Done when

The capability registry names, per token, which plugin provides it (a spec field: `Clause-②` and a contract review), and the CLI check matches on that identity instead of the package.
